test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the Panchayati Raj system in India as per the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __'**Gram Corporation**'.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Gram Sabha, Gram Panchayat, and Sarpanch** are parts of the Panchayat Raj system whereas **Gram Corporation** is an independent organization constituted by some people.
 
• **The Panchayati Raj **system is the system that ensures the participation of individuals at the grass-root level.
 
• The **Balwant Rai Mehta Committee** recommended **3- tier** structure consisting of **Zilla Parishad** at the District Level, Panchayat Samiti at the Block Level, and Gram Panchayat at the Village Level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Panchayati Raj system is included in the **State List of the Constitution** of India under the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992** is related to the Panchayati Raj system.
 
• **Rajasthan** is the first state to implement the Panchayati Raj system on 2nd October 1959 in its **Nagaur district**.
 
• **Balwant Rai Mehta Committee recommended the Panchayati Raj system for the first time in India.**
 
• **Ashok Mehta Committee** appointed in December 1977 by Janata Party Government in 1978 submitted its report stating the replacement of the 3-tier system by a 2-tier system consisting of **Mandal Panchayats** at the base and Zila Parishad at the top.
 
• **24th April** every year Panchayati Raj day is celebrated.
 
• **Part IX (Articles 243 to 243O)** of the Constitution of India deals with the Panchayati Raj system.
